title: Universal step-graded interface screening and Schrieffer-Wolff quasiparticle bounds in Si/SiGe spin-valley qubits and superconducting Josephson circuits

creators.name: Ownby, Gracen
creators.affiliation: University of Oklahoma, Norman, Oklahoma, USA

description: Complete mathematical proofs, 2,000-sample Monte Carlo verification suite, atomistic tight-binding valley-splitting benchmarks, and 8-state Bogoliubov-Lindblad master-equation benchmarks for universal step-graded interface screening in Si/SiGe spin-valley qubits and superconducting Josephson circuits.
